Frequently asked questions,
answered
What is a Virtual Job Tryout®?
The Virtual Job Tryout® is a Hirevue assessment that immerses candidates in job-related tasks. It helps candidates better understand the role and assess their fit, while providing hiring teams with valuable insights into candidates’ abilities to perform the job.
What types of jobs is the Virtual Job Tryout® best suited for?
We currently have more than 40 job-specific Virtual Job Tryouts available, for entry-level to manager roles in a variety of industries such as banking, healthcare, manufacturing, sales, retail, and more. We also offer Virtual Job Tryouts that are more general in nature, for individual contributors and graduates, or to test for business essentials such as leadership, service, or operations.
Can candidates complete the tryout on their own devices?
Yes, candidates can complete the assessment on their own time on any device with an internet connection, including smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
What kind of data or insights do employers get from the assessments?
Because the Virtual Job Tryout® measures multiple facets of a job, they offer a wealth of valuable insights about candidates. Hiring teams receive a candidate fit profile which rates the candidate in the competencies important to the job, as well as how likely they are to perform and stay in the role. The report also includes candidate strengths and areas of development, as well as recommended follow up questions for future stages of the hiring process. These insights make it more likely a team will make a quality hire.
